I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It is the full 1280px onboarding screen inside `<div id="component">`, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Fonts:** DESIGN.md calls for Unbounded and Archivo, but there are no font files in the folder and no external loading is allowed. The page names both fonts, so they only appear if installed locally. Otherwise it falls back to the system sans-serif.
- **Interaction states:** I added hover and focus-visible styles on the buttons. The Connect and Continue buttons are not wired to anything, because there is no JavaScript.
- **Content and layout:** All the text is exactly as you gave it. The heading is shown in all caps through CSS, as the design file asks. The content sits in columns 3–10 of the 12-column grid, with 64px margins and 32px gutters.
- **Design rules:** Colors, type sizes, spacing and radii come only from the DESIGN.md lists.
